LESSON: KUANDIKA 5.3.1 INSHA YA MAELEKEZO

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha ya Maelekezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha ya Maelekezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya maelekezo
2. kutambua aina za insha za maelekezo
3. kujadili sifa za insha ya maelekezo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya maelekezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya insha ya maelekezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua aina za insha za maelekezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua aina za insha za maelekezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kujadili sifa za insha ya maelekezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili sifa za insha ya maelekezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha ya Maelekezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha ya Maelekezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha ya Maelekezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha ya Maelekezo.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya insha ya maelekezo

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha ya Maelekezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 5.3.1 Insha ya Maelekezo important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya maelekezo
2. kutambua aina za insha za maelekezo
3. kujadili sifa za insha ya maelekezo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
